summary.text: Heavenly Summary Earthly Norm is a heaven path killer move named when Paradise Earth uses it.

claims.text: Paradise Earth shouts for everyone to protect him and retreats to the center of the group. The other immortals protect him and give him precious time to use his killer move. A mysterious aura spreads from his body and charges toward the azure sphere like an air wave. The killer move is extremely profound. It can restore heaven and earth to its normal state, and it is the nemesis of battlefield killer moves. The azure sphere is already enduring pressure from Fang Yuan. When heavenly summary earthly norm hits, it immediately collapses. Fang Yuan gives a loud shout as he flies out.

Fang Yuan asks Paradise Earth to lend him a hand again. Paradise Earth activates heavenly summary earthly norm a second time. After using the killer move, his orifices start bleeding and his face becomes pale as paper. Formless air currents move forward. Everywhere they go, starry paths break down, turning into nothingness. Without the starry paths, it is difficult for Star Constellation Immortal Venerable to move Qin Ding Ling.

Paradise Earth activates heavenly summary earthly norm again. He has the same intention as Fang Yuan: dismantle Star Constellation Chessboard Formation first. The heaven path killer move’s power is beyond ordinary. Everywhere it goes, starry paths vanish and starlight dissipates, restoring the original void. Star Constellation Immortal Venerable frowns and throws out numerous stars. Most still target Fang Yuan, but a small portion attack Paradise Earth. Even though Paradise Earth only has pseudo venerable cultivation, he has converted to heaven path. Star Constellation Immortal Venerable is unable to ascertain his methods for the moment, so she has to be on alert against him.

After Fang Yuan killed Paradise Earth, he found only two heaven path Immortal Gu in the immortal aperture: heavenly web Gu and heavenly birth Gu. There were also many other Immortal Gu, including information path Immortal Gu Summary, which can let a Gu Immortal deduce the general summary of complicated information, and rule path Immortal Gu Normal, which can let the target recover to a normal condition. By using these Immortal Gu, Paradise Earth formed many heaven path killer moves like heavenly web protection veil, emotionless heaven and earth, heavenly summary earthly norm, and others. These Immortal Gu were all destroyed by Paradise Earth’s will before his death.

While Fang Yuan refines Eastern Sea’s natural refinement path dao marks, he also continues deducing heaven path killer moves. Not long after, he gains some results, but he is not satisfied yet. This newly deduced heaven path killer move is not much different from Paradise Earth’s heavenly summary earthly norm. Heavenly summary earthly norm is able to arrange heaven path dao marks to allow the target to recover to a normal condition, and it is the counter to battlefield killer moves. Fang Yuan’s deductions allowed heavenly summary earthly norm to go one step further. When used in the sovereign immortal aperture, that deduced result could change the immortal aperture’s environment into the environment of the five regions and two heavens. The natural dao marks of the five regions and two heavens were conflicting, so after converting them the sovereign immortal aperture’s dao marks would also conflict. Using it hundreds or thousands of times could make the aperture like the five regions and two heavens, but Fang Yuan would lose the advantage of non-conflicting dao marks, a cost he could not accept.

Fang Yuan’s heaven path foundation is as such. He has heaven path grandmaster attainment level, various killer moves like heaven envies heroic geniuses, heavenly web protection veil, emotionless heaven and earth, heavenly summary earthly norm, obscured heavenly secret, and others, as well as Immortal Gu like Heavenly Web, Heavenly Secret, Heaven’s Envy, and Heavenly Birth.
